First a Dream - cover

First a Dream

By Jim Clayton , Bill Retherford
Buy the book
Amazon GET Barnes & Noble GET

About the book

Jim Clayton tells, with Bill Retherford, how a boy raised during the Depression built Clayton Homes, a mobile home business, and draws lessons from it on leadership, motivating a team, and the culture and values a company needs at any size.
Warren Buffett was reported to credit the book, a gift from University of Tennessee students, with inspiring his investment in Clayton Homes in 2003.
We hope you love the books people recommend! Just so you know, The CEO Library may collect a share of sales or other compensation from the links on this page.

This book has 1 recommendation

Warren Buffett (CEO/Berkshire Hathaway)
Buffett credits Clayton's autobiography with inspiring him to invest in Clayton Homes in 2003. In his 2003 shareholder letter, he wrote that the book was a gift to him from students at the University of Tennessee. Buffett told the students how much he enjoyed the book, and they urged him to call Kevin Clayton, Jim's son and the company's CEO, to deliver the praise directly.

This is a captivating "rags to riches" story, as a young boy discovers during the Depression that hard work and sheer perseverance are the keys to living his dreams.
